title.en: Greenland hid a lake. Satellites caught the ice rising 10 metres.
title.zh: 格陵兰藏着一座湖，卫星看见冰面升了十米。

summary.en: Lake B temporarily stores meltwater beneath an ice cap. Better understanding of its delayed release can improve hydrological models, not stop warming.
summary.zh: 冰下B湖暂存融水，延迟排放。认识这段隐秘水路有助改善水文模型，并非阻止变暖。

title.en: TSMC booked $46.72 billion. Its 2nm ramp still has to deliver the next quarter.
title.zh: 台积电一季营收467.2亿美元，二纳米还得兑现下一季。

summary.en: TSMC reports strong leading-edge demand and 2nm at 8% of wafer revenue. Its $52.3–54.3 billion Q4 outlook is guidance, not money already earned.
summary.zh: 台积电称先进制程需求强劲，二纳米占晶圆营收8%。第四季523至543亿美元仍是指引，尚未入账。
